TOPIC 9.4
Defining and 
Differentiating Vector-
Valued Functions

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

CHA-3.H
Calculate derivatives of 
vector-valued functions.   
bc only

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

CHA-3.H.1
Methods for calculating derivatives of real-
valued functions can be extended to vector-
valued functions. bc only

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

CHA-3
Derivatives allow us to solve real-world problems involving rates of change.
